selected.access: Official API author abstract only; no full manuscript review
selected.summary: This preprint presents an assembly-based HG002 benchmark that extends small- and structural-variant evaluation into repetitive and previously difficult genomic regions. Separate and combined benchmark sets across reference assemblies provide resources for validating sequencing pipelines; the curated manuscript is a preprint.

version_history.title: A Unified Comparison of 10X Genomics and Parse Biosciences scRNA-seq Technologies

selected.access: Official API author abstract only; no full manuscript review
selected.summary: This preprint compares seven matched sample pairs from five studies and separates priming-related biases from larger platform-level differences between 10x and Parse. Reported differences in nuclear RNA representation and comparable background contamination caution against treating measurements as interchangeable; the study focuses on gene counts and composition rather than a universal platform ranking.

version_history.title: Navigating the rapidly evolving landscape of sequencing-based spatial transcriptomics technologies: a comprehensive multi-platform benchmark

selected.access: Official API author abstract only; no full manuscript review
selected.summary: This preprint compares sequencing-based spatial transcriptomics platforms across tissue types and preservation methods, examining capture architecture, capture efficiency and spatial accuracy. Its proposed operational metrics may help experimental planning, but performance remains dependent on the tested assays and specimens.

version_history.title: RNA and protein are not interchangeable in single-cell spatial multi-omics

selected.access: Official API author abstract only; no full manuscript review
selected.summary: This preprint compares paired RNA and protein measurements for 21 targets in lung and prostate cancer specimens. Marker-dependent agreement and divergent spatial patterns, including for several checkpoint molecules, support orthogonal protein validation before interpreting spatial RNA as a protein proxy.

version_history.title: Genetic Perturbation Prediction Models Fail Out-of-Distribution: A Rigorous Benchmark and Systematic Evaluation

selected.access: Official API author abstract only; no full manuscript review
selected.summary: This preprint evaluates 20 perturbation prediction models using functionally separated training and test sets. Performance deteriorated under these harder conditions, with complex architectures offering no consistent advantage over simpler baselines in the reported comparisons, emphasizing realistic validation before substituting predictions for experiments.

version_history.title: Order Matters: Ambient RNA correction confounds doublet detection in single-cell RNA sequencing

selected.access: Official API author abstract only; no full manuscript review
selected.summary: This preprint evaluates ambient RNA correction and doublet detection using engineered and multiplexed datasets. Doublet detection generally worked better before decontX or SoupX correction, with CellBender an exception, suggesting that preprocessing order should be validated rather than assumed interchangeable.
